data.name: Makhfi
data.gender_notes: Makhfi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'khafa', meaning 'to cover, hide, or conceal'. In Islamic tradition, the name Makhfi evokes the idea of a protected, safeguarded, or well-guarded individual. The name Makhfi carries the meaning “Hidden, Concealed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Makhfi usually hope their child will grow to embody hidden, concealed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the idea of inner strength and resilience, as well as the protection and guidance of Allah.
data.etymology: Makhfi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hidden, Concealed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Makhfi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Makhfi

In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with spiritual concealment and protection. Makhfi is also used as a given name among Muslims, reflecting the virtues of humility and modesty. The name has historical significance in Islamic mysticism and is mentioned in various Quranic commentaries
